fix_code:
S = input()
char1 = S[0]
char2 = None

# Find the two distinct characters
for char in S:
    if char != char1:
        char2 = char
        break

# Count occurrences of each character
count1 = S.count(char1)
count2 = S.count(char2)

# Determine the unique character
unique_char = char1 if count1 == 1 else char2

# Find the index of the unique character
unique_index = S.index(unique_char)

# Print the 1-based index of the unique character
print(unique_index + 1)
